prompt:

| Return 3m            | +29.3% |
| Return 1m            | +10.1% |
| Return 1w            | +3.7% |
| Range position (63d) | 93% |
| 21d realized vol     | 32% |
| Last close           | 186.50 |
Based only on the above and knowledge predating 2026-02-05, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock. Choose exactly one label from: BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:

raw_response:
The stock has demonstrated strong positive momentum across all observed timeframes (3m, 1m, 1w), indicating a robust upward trend. Its high range position (93% over 63 days) suggests it's trading near its recent highs, which, combined with the positive returns, points to continued strength rather than an imminent reversal. While the 21d realized volatility is moderate, the consistent positive returns outweigh this, suggesting the upward trend is likely to persist in the short term.

DECISION: BUY
